comparisons.reason: Same source (OC_comments) and the same 0/1/null rules, but the constructs differ. Left is any specific real-world example cited as support, including a person, study, statistic, or event. Right requires a concrete analogy: a real-world case used as a comparison to the issue, drawn from outside the OP's scenario. Right is a narrower subtype, and it adds an explicit exclusion for restating the OP's examples. A comment can cite a real example as direct evidence without making an analogy, so the two features would label such comments differently.
